---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a change to hindsight's scope or output
title: ""
labels: enhancement
---

**What would this let you do that you can't today?**

**Does it fit hindsight's scope?** Read `CONTRIBUTING.md` first --
zero runtime dependencies, no per-program/per-DEX decoders, no number in
the output that isn't traced back to arithmetic over on-chain data. A
request that needs an API key, a paid data feed, or a model call in the
numbers (not the pattern paragraph) is probably a different tool.

**Proposed behavior.** If this changes the CLI surface, the report shape,
or a benchmark's formula, sketch the exact output you'd expect.

**Would this need a new external dependency?** If yes, say so up front --
it will very likely be the deciding factor.
